'''Team Two''' was a unit of ten [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] under the command of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Modigal Glave]] who took part in [[Operation Peacemaker]] on the [[Combat Moon]]. They were assigned to kill the [[S'krrr (species)|S'krrr]] warrior [[Sh'shak]].<ref name="AJ9" />
